title: Love Live! Hasu no Sora Jogakuin School Idol Club Anime's Special Video Previews TV Footage
content:
The " Love Live! Series 15th Anniversary Love Live! Fes" presented a special promotional video for the television anime of the Love Live! Hasu no Sora Jogakuin School Idol Club project on Saturday. The video previews the newly animated television footage for the first time, and it also previews the song "Dream Believers (106th Class Start Ver.)" by the in-story 106th class of Hasu no Sora Joga kuin School Idol Club.

The anime will show the characters of the 106th class in stories set between April and June of their school year. (The game and anime film previously only featured characters from the 103rd to 105th class.)

Gō Kurosaki ( Shikizakura ) is directing the project at Sublimation . Fumiaki Maruto ( Engage Kiss , SI-VIS: The Sound of Heroes , White Album 2 ) is writing the scripts. Haruko Iizuka ( Ensemble Stars! , Tamayura ) is designing the characters, Kaito Hamakawa is directing the CG, Keiichi Nozaki ( Ongaku Shōjo , L/R: Licensed by Royalty ) is directing the sound, and Yoshiaki Fujisawa ( Apocalypse Hotel , Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation ) is composing the music with Lantis handling music production.

Other staff members include:

• Design Works: Yū Kisaragi

• Art Director: Yasuhiro Okumura

• Stage Concept Art: Marina Manode

• Color Key Artist: Hikari Komiya

• Compositing Director of Photography: Fumika Takahashi, Hiroshi Tanaka

• Editing: Manabu Kamino

The staff remains mostly the same as the Love Live! Hasu no Sora Jogakuin School Idol Club Bloom Garden Party anime film, with the exception of Hikari Komiya as the color key artist (replacing Emi Chiba ), and the addition of Fumika Takahashi as compositing director of photography alongside the returning Hiroshi Tanaka .

The seven-episode anime will premiere on January 10 at 10:30 p.m. (8:30 a.m. EST) on the Tokyo MX channel, followed by BS11 , Sun TV , KBS Kyoto , TV Aichi , RKB Mainichi Broadcasting , and Shizuoka Broadcasting System later that day. It will also run on January 11 on Hokkaido Broadcasting, and on January 17 on Hokuriku Broadcasting .

The Love Live! Hasu no Sora Jogakuin School Idol Club Bloom Garden Party 3D anime film opened in theaters in Japan on May 8. The film follows the final day before graduation of the 103rd class at the Hasu no Sora Girls' Academy.

The " Hasu no Sora Jōgakuin School Idol Club " idol group is part of the Love Live! franchise , and includes Kaho Hinoshita, Sayaka Murano, Kozue Otomune, Tsuzuri Yugiri, Rurino Osawa, and Megumi Fujishima, among others. The group is primarily featured in the Link! Like! Love Live! smartphone game app, which launched on April 15, 2023. Haruko Iizuka ( Little Busters! , Horimiya ) is designing the characters for the project. Odd No. Inc. is publishing the game. The group's first album Dream Believers debuted on March 29, 2023.

The game ended service on June 30 earlier this year. Odd No. filed for bankruptcy on August 5.

The project lets fans experience the story "together with school idols over 365 days" and let players "walk the path to graduation with the girls." In addition to the smartphone app, the idol club members (and their cast) stream videos, appear in magazines, release music CDs, hold concerts, among other efforts in various forms of media. A manga launched in Shueisha 's Ultra Jump magazine in November 2023.

The Love Live! school idol franchise launched in 2010 and has since spawned the Love Live! Sunshine!! , Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club , Love Live! Superstar!! and most recently, Ikizu Live! Love Live! Bluebird project spinoffs.
author: ANN

title: World Trigger Tops Oricon's Comic Ranking for October
content:
The 30th volume of Daisuke Ashihara 's World Trigger manga topped the chart, selling 280,785 copies. The volume shipped in Japan on October 2. The manga's anime adaptation is getting a " Reboot Project " that will re-adapt the original manga from the first chapter and will include the Border Enlistment Arc, Large-Scale Invasion Arc, and B-Rank Wars Arc. Toei Animation will continue to produce the anime, and the anime's staff stated it will be a "powered up World Trigger 1st Season."

The 33rd volume of Taiki Kawakami 's That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ( Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken ) manga, based on Fuse and Mitz Vah 's light novel series of the same title, ranked at #2 selling 261,337 copies. The volume shipped in Japan on October 8. The manga is notable for being the basis of the story's long-running anime adaptation (as opposed to the light novel series itself). Kodansha USA Publishing releases the manga in English. The third cours (quarter of a year) of the anime adaptation's fourth season will debut in July 2027.

The 109th volume of Gōshō Aoyama 's Case Closed manga ranked at #3 selling 209,686 copies. The volume shipped in Japan on October 16. Detective Conan: 30-gō Satsujin Jiken ( The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30 ), the franchise 's first new two-hour special in 10 years, debuted in Japan on September 25. Detective Conan: Highway no Datenshi ( Detective Conan: Fallen Angel of the Highway ), the franchise 's 29th film , opened in Japan on April 10.

The top 20 compiled print volumes of manga or comics in Japan in October 2026, according to Oricon, were:

About ORICON:

ORICON is a company that provides rankings and news. Since 1967, it has been compiling data on record sales in Japan and publishing rankings; since 2008, it has also published the “ORICON Book Ranking” based on sales figures. The company holds a vast amount of data on the Japanese entertainment market. It operates “ORICON NEWS,” Japan's largest entertainment website, and runs “Japan Anime News” as its global version.
author: ANN

title: 'Toaru Anbu no Item' Reveals Additional Cast, Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kazuma Kamachi 's Toaru Anbu no Item ( A Certain Dark Side's Item ) light novel revealed additional cast and a promotional video on Saturday. The anime premiered on October 9 at 10.30 p.m. on AT-X, followed by Tokyo MX and BS11.

Cast Kaede Ibotanokikouji: Aya Yamane ( Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai ) Kamitsu Hanayama: Yuuki Hirose ( Kowloon Generic Romance ) Laspezia Inoue: Konomi Inagaki ( Kirei ni Shitemoraemasu ka. ) Hiyoko Aiyose: Misaki Kuno ( Tenmaku no Jaadugar )

Tatsuyuki Nagai ( Toaru Kagaku no Railgun ) is directing the anime at J.C.Staff . Shougo Yasukawa ( Shokugeki no Souma ) is handling the series composition, while Shigeki Kimoto ( Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka ) is designing the characters. Maiko Iuchi ( Akudama Drive ) is composing the music.

Kamachi began penning the spin-off light novel under the Dengeki Bunko imprint in March 2023, featuring illustrations by Nilitsu ( Shokei Shoujo no Virgin Road ). Kadokawa published the seventh volume on October 9.

Dengeki Daioh began serializing a manga adaptation by strelka ( Hinowa ga Yuku! ) in October 2023. Kadokawa released the second volume in April 2025.

PV (VS Item ver.)

title: Love Live! Hasunosora Anime Reveals New Trailer
content:
Love Live! Hasunosora Girls’ High School Idol Club anime revealed a new trailer on Saturday. The anime will premiere on January 10, 2027. Studio Sublimation is animating the series.

Go Kurosaki is directing the series, with Haruko Iizuka on character designs, and Yoshiaki Fujisawa on music. The voice cast consists of:

• Nozomi Nirei as Kaho Hinoshita

• Kokona Nonaka as Sayaka Murano

• Kanna Kan as Rurino Osawa

• Hina Sakurai as Ginko Momose

• Fuka Hayama as Kosuzu Kachimachi

• Rin Kurusu as Hime Anyoji

• Miu Miyake as Ceras Yanagida Lilienfeld

• Amane Shindo as Izumi Katsuragi

• Niina Hanamiya as Kozue Otomune

• Kona Tsukine as Megumi Fujishima

• Kotoko Sasaki as Tsuzuri Yugiri

• Julia Hoshimiya as Maika Kinjo

• Kana Asahi as Aoi Reisawa

• Kanae Yuasa as Mion Shinowa

The Hasunosora Girls’ High School Idol Club is part of the Link! Like! Love Live! project, which is centered around a smartphone application that launched on April 15, 2023. The members are introduced and developed within the app, which includes interactive storytelling, live 3D performances, and social media-style engagement with the idols. They made their musical debut with the song “Dream Believers,” which served as their first group single.

title: 'Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu' Gets 5th Season
content:
The Re:Zero 10th Anniversary Starlight Party special event announced a fifth season on Saturday, revealing an ultra teaser visual (pictured).

Produced by White Fox , the first anime season adapting Tappei Nagatsuki 's isekai fantasy light novel debuted in Spring 2016, covering the first nine volumes. The Memory Snow side-story OVA premiered in theaters in October 2018, followed by the Hyouketsu no Kizuna ( The Frozen Bond ) prequel OVA in November 2019.

The second season aired in split cours, with the first cours airing in 13 episodes in Summer 2020 and the 12-episode second cours in Winter 2021.

The third season aired with the Shuugeki-hen ( Attack arc ) from October 2024 to November 2024. The Hangeki-hen ( Counterattack arc ) aired from February 2025 to March 2025.

The fourth season began airing with the Soshitsu-hen ( Loss Arc ) on April 8 and ended on July 17. The Dakkan-hen ( Recapture Arc ) aired from August 12 to September 30. Crunchyroll streamed the series with multiple subtitles and dubs.

Nagatsuki originally began penning the series on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in April 2012. Kadokawa began printing the novel with illustrations by Shinichirou Ootsuka through its MF Bunko J imprint in January 2014 and published the 46th volume on September 25, with the 47th volume scheduled for December 25.

• Funimation originally licensed the anime series in North America and released the first season on home video in two installments in June 2018 and February 2019. Crunchyroll released the second and the third season on Blu-ray in September 2023 and July 2026, respectively.

Yen Press licensed the light novel in December 2015 and published the 29th volume on July 14, with the 30th volume scheduled for a December 8 release. The company also publishes the manga adaptations, the Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu Ex ( Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Ex ) side novel and Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu Tanpenshuu ( Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Short Story Collection ).

title: Re:ZERO Season 5 Anime Officially Announced
content:
Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 5 has been officially announced. An ultra teaser visual was also released. Tappei Nagatsuki also released a comment, which you can read below.

Congratulations on the production of Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 5! Congratulations! And thank you very much! I’m the original author, Tappei Nagatsuki! Season 5! What an incredible number! I have nothing but gratitude for everyone who has supported the series all the way to this point, and for all the staff and cast members who have continued to bring the story to audiences. And of course, that gratitude also goes to the characters who keep challenging their cruel destinies! The sixth arc covered in Season 4 has been called one of the most difficult parts of Re:ZERO, but don’t worry! The journey through the seventh arc is every bit as brutal, with the difficulty cranked all the way up to inferno. The story continues with the same reassuringly heart-breaking design you’ve come to expect—yes, “heart-breaking” is intentional! Of course, it won’t all be hardship. There will also be plenty of new encounters, exciting developments, and scenes I can’t wait to see—and show you—in anime form! Let’s make the journey ahead one that goes beyond anything you can imagine! Now then, Natsuki Subaru—the next battle begins! For Season 5, shake with anticipation and excitement together with the author as we wait!

The first season of the anime aired in 2016, adapting the light novel series by Tappei Nagatsuki and illustrated by Shinichirou Otsuka. The series announced 10 major projects for its 10th anniversary this year.

You can also see the Japanese version of the visual below:

title: Gushing Over Magical Girls Season 2 Reveals New Visual, Trailer, 2027 Release Date
content:
Gushing Over Magical Girls Season 2 revealed a new visual and trailer that announce the 2027 release date.

The cast will reprise their roles for the sequel:

• Fuka Izumi as Utena Hiiragi/Magia Baiser

• Misato Fukuen as Venalita

• Aoi Koga as Kiwi Araga / Leopard

• Shiori Sugiura as Korisu Morino / Nero Alice

• Yuka Aisaka as Matama Akoya/Loco Musica

• Minami Tsuda as Nemo Anemo/Leberblume

• Kaori Maeda as Haruka Hanabishi/Magia Magenta

• Mayuko Kazama as Sayo Minakami / Magia Azul

• Misaki Ikeda as Kaoruko Tenkawa / Magia Sulfur

Asahi Productions animated the first season with Masato Suzuki and Atsushi Otsuki as directors. Noboru Kimura was in charge of the series composition, while Tomoka Otaki was on character designs and Yasuharu Takanashi , Akinari Suzuki, and Johannes Nilsson composed the music.

Gushing Over Magical Girls anime is based on a magical girl manga series by Akihiro Ononaka. It initially began its serialization on Takeshobo’s Storia Dash website in March 2019. J-Novel Club licenses the manga in English and they describe the plot as follows: “Hi, I’m Hiiragi Utena. I’m a normal magical-girl-loving middle school girl—or at least I was, but then some talking mascot showed up out of the blue and cast a spell on me! Now’s my chance to join my beloved magical girls as…a villain? Hang on, something’s wrong with my outfit! This can’t be happening! Watch this shy magical-girl fan transform into a sadistic dominatrix! When good and evil collide, who will be the one to submit?!”
author: Anime Corner

Fuka Izumi as Utena Hiiragi/Magia Baiser
Misato Fukuen as Venalita
Aoi Koga as Kiwi Araga / Leopard
Shiori Sugiura as Korisu Morino / Nero Alice
Yuka Aisaka as Matama Akoya/Loco Musica
Minami Tsuda as Nemo Anemo/Leberblume
Kaori Maeda as Haruka Hanabishi/Magia Magenta
Mayuko Kazama as Sayo Minakami / Magia Azul
Misaki Ikeda as Kaoruko Tenkawa / Magia Sulfur

Asahi Productions animated the first season with Masato Suzuki and Atsushi Otsuki as directors. Noboru Kimura was in charge of the series composition, while Tomoka Otaki was on character designs and Yasuharu Takanashi , Akinari Suzuki, and Johannes Nilsson composed the music.

Gushing Over Magical Girls anime is based on a magical girl manga series by Akihiro Ononaka. It initially began its serialization on Takeshobo’s Storia Dash website in March 2019. J-Novel Club licenses the manga in English and they describe the plot as follows: “Hi, I’m Hiiragi Utena. I’m a normal magical-girl-loving middle school girl—or at least I was, but then some talking mascot showed up out of the blue and cast a spell on me! Now’s my chance to join my beloved magical girls as…a villain? Hang on, something’s wrong with my outfit! This can’t be happening! Watch this shy magical-girl fan transform into a sadistic dominatrix! When good and evil collide, who will be the one to submit?!”

title: Gushing Over Magical Girls Anime's 2nd Season Debuts in 2027
content:
Kadokawa revealed on Saturday that the second season of the anime based on Akihiro Ononaka 's Gushing Over Magical Girls ( Mahō Shōjo ni Akogarete ) manga will debut in 2027, under the title Mahō Shōjo ni Akogarete Season 2 ( Gushing Over Magical Girls Season 2 ). The new season was first announced in October 2024.

The company revealed the news in a birthday celebration video for Magia Baiser on Saturday.

Kadokawa also revealed an "ultra teaser visual," and confirmed the new season's returning cast and staff. The returning cast includes:

• Fūka Izumi as Utena Hiiragi/Magia Baiser

• Aoi Koga as Kiwi Araga/Leopard

• Shiori Sugiura as Korisu Morino/Nero Alice

• Yuka Aisaka as Matama Akoya/Loco Musica

• Minami Tsuda as Nemo Anemo/Leberblume

• Kaori Maeda as Haruka Hanabishi/Magia Magenta

• Mayuko Kazama as Sayo Minakami/Magia Azul

• Misaki Ikeda as Kaoruko Tenkawa/Magia Sulfur

• Misato Fukuen as Venalita

• Kana Asumi as Vatz

Masato Suzuki and Atsushi Ōtsuki are both returning to co-direct the anime at Asahi Production . Noboru Kimura is again overseeing the series scripts, and Yasuka Ōtaki is again designing the characters.

The first season debuted on the AT-X channel in January 2024, and the series also aired on Tokyo MX , BS11 , Sun TV , and KBS Kyoto . The anime has three different versions: the TV broadcast version, the "gushing" version on streaming services, and the "ultra-gushing" version on Blu-ray Disc and DVD. The TV broadcast version censors the audio and visuals, the "gushing" version censors the audio and some of the visuals, and the "ultra-gushing" version does not censor either.

HIDIVE streamed the anime as it aired in Japan, and has the series' "gushing" version available for streaming.

Ononaka launched the manga in Takeshobo 's Manga Life Storia magazine in 2019. After the magazine ceased publication in July 2019, the manga moved to the Storia Dash website.

The manga went on hiatus in March 2024 due to Ononaka's health, and resumed serialization in October 2025 on Takeshobo 's Takecomi! website .

J-Novel Club licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Hi, I'm Hiiragi Utena. I'm a normal magical-girl-loving middle school girl—or at least I was, but then some talking mascot showed up out of the blue and cast a spell on me! Now's my chance to join my beloved magical girls as...a villain? Hang on, something's wrong with my outfit! This can't be happening! Watch this shy magical-girl fan transform into a sadistic dominatrix! When good and evil collide, who will be the one to submit?!

Takeshobo published the manga's 13th volume in Japan on September 16. The manga has more than 3 million copies in circulation worldwide, including digital copies sold.
